description: Template for per-article remediation tracking in the second-audit swarm. Coordinator fills this when any lane reports FAIL or BLOCKER. The remediation worker (typically Codex) updates the remediation_applied section. The re-audit lane appends the re_audit section.

failure.finding_detail: Exact claim text, file path, line/section, and expected vs actual evidence
failure.lane_output_reference: Path to the lane audit .md file that reported this failure

evidence_quotes.expected: string (what the source or standard requires)
evidence_quotes.actual: string (what the article or question currently says)

remediation_assignment.assignment_reason: Why this worker was chosen for the fix
remediation_assignment.scope_limit: Exactly what files and fields the worker may edit

remediation_applied.notes: Any ambiguity or risk introduced by the fix

re_audit.status: pending | assigned | in_progress | pass | fail | parked
re_audit.assigned_lane: same lane that originally found the failure
re_audit.finding_delta: What changed from the original failure, if anything
re_audit.evidence_reference: Path to the re-audit lane output file

coordinator_decision.decision_reason: Why the coordinator accepted, parked, or escalated

blocking_dependencies: article_uuids or source_families that must be resolved first

pass_fail_blocker_definitions.PASS: All lane checks satisfied. No warnings that rise to failure.
pass_fail_blocker_definitions.FAIL: A specific, correctable defect was found. Enter remediation loop.
pass_fail_blocker_definitions.BLOCKER: A severe defect risking student harm, legal liability, or data corruption. Immediate remediation; may park if unresolvable.
pass_fail_blocker_definitions.N_A: Lane does not apply. Does not affect overall verdict.

severity_definitions.correctable: Worker can fix the defect with an edit, hash update, or metadata repair.
severity_definitions.requires_source_narrowing: Article claims must be narrowed to match available raw sources.
severity_definitions.requires_human_sme: Legal/code interpretation or pedagogical judgment beyond AI auditor confidence.
severity_definitions.unresolvable: Raw source is missing and no narrowing is possible; or defect is structural and would require full rewrite.
